setBy: Kane, relayed by the coordinator on 26 September, replacing the 5-point margin for every Jev decision
note: Received after round 3 had run, so it was not committed before that run. As instructed, the change is recorded with its date and round 3 is judged under it (score-round3.mjs, kaneVerdict). Round 3's own committed bar (round3-bar.json) and its verdict stand unchanged beside it.
rule: A decision goes on for Pro when: the Jev-when-sure path is right on more models than the rule; an exact two-sided McNemar test gives p below maxP; and the Jev-when-sure path makes no more harmful mistakes than the rule. The size of the win does not matter.
harmful: For the date table: a wrong existing table marked as the date table, or a new one generated when a good one exists. Counted on the table decision.
